snippet.title: MUSTER — Official Reveal Trailer | Roguelite Autobattler
snippet.description:
Play the free MUSTER demo on Steam and wishlist the game → https://store.steampowered.com/app/5127720/MUSTER/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=prelaunch&utm_content=reveal-trailer

Every dig shapes the next fight.

MUSTER is a party-based RPG autobattler with Minesweeper-style dungeon crawling. Read the clues, uncover battles and loot, and build a warband from 20 different characters, each with three specializations and talent-based progression.

Equip and position a party of up to five diggers, then watch your plan play out in automatic real-time hex battles. Your party composition, talents, equipment, and formation shape the fight.

Find new items and relics each run. Extract surviving characters to preserve their progression, or risk going deeper.

• 20 characters, each with three specializations
• Talent-based character progression
• Equipment, relics, and party synergies
• Pre-battle positioning on hex arenas
• Minesweeper-style dungeon exploration
• Two six-floor barrows and Endless mode

The free demo is available now on Steam. Coming to Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Official website → https://www.mustergame.com/
Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/playmustergame/
TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@mustergame7

Developed and published by CapLock Games.

#MUSTER #Autobattler #RPG
